name: DPCLock claimToken pays DPC at manipulable spot quotes
summary: DPCLock.claimToken computes its unlock multiple and the DPC payout from PancakeRouter getAmountsOut spot quotes on the FSP/USDT and FSP/DPC pairs: the FSP pool value and a USDT->FSP->DPC conversion. With flash-loaned USDT, attackers skewed those pairs, locked FSP through swapDPC, and called claimToken for inflated DPC amounts, which they sold back through the pairs. The first attacker did this twice; two copycats repeated it in the next two blocks.
notes: Direct, non-upgradeable DPCLock runtime. The owner's setTokenContract calls (DPC, staking, FSP/DPC pair) and setOldLockData migrations are ordinary wiring and position imports; the spot-quote pricing is in the code from deployment.

Exact DPC depletion of DPCLock 0xc697e28f2fc7b8d6734d8d91cb280e99067ebde3 over five campaign transactions, valued at the USDT the campaign pulled out of the FSP/USDT pair 0x7c1f8f5d8d000b00a2eaa3c21071dbca18f6825d, where the stolen DPC was sold. DPC has no independent market quote: spot implies about 200,000 USD per DPC against a 23-DPC pool. Flash-loan legs net out within each transaction.
